purpose: More expressive homepage backgrounds following screenshot feedback

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: expressive artistic website section BACKGROUND, not a mockup. Landscape 1536x1024. Design a beautiful contemporary abstract pattern for SalesHubNepal, a premium beverage distributor. Main material: sculptural bottle-glass inspired flowing contours, precise fine nested curvilinear lines etched into translucent dark glass, sweeping liquid-meniscus arcs and overlapping broad glass ribbons. Near-black midnight charcoal / deep petrol foundation #0D1B1E, graceful muted teal refracted edges and subtle champagne-bronze light accents. Composition explicitly for a website section: clearly visible large-scale decorative design throughout the TOP QUARTER and RIGHT EDGE, three or four broad sweeping elliptical ribbon structures flowing diagonally from upper right toward lower left, nested fine lines following these curves. Rich layered depth, polished satin finish, architectural precision, refined editorial luxury. Left-center between 12%-35% from top should be quieter dark area for the actual white heading; lower 65% will mostly be covered by product cards so do NOT put all the beautiful artwork only at the bottom. Pattern should be genuinely visible at normal screen brightness, medium contrast, interesting visual rhythm, elegantly integrated warm amber reflections, not a mostly flat dark texture. No typography, no logos, no real products, no bottle silhouettes, no wallpaper icons, no random grain, no frost speckling, no droplets, no marble, no smoke, no cosmic nebula, no neon.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: expressive artistic background for a premium beverage distributor website people/contact section. Landscape 1536x1024. Create a beautiful cohesive abstract pattern in sculpted opaline glass: large overlapping translucent curved glass ribbons and embossed nested flowing contour lines, inspired by liquid meniscus and the geometry of bottle glass. Bright pearl-white / silver-white base #F1F3F2, pale mineral blue-teal glass edges, restrained champagne-gold hairline accents. Smooth polished layered glass, elegant shadows and luminous highlights, clearly visible sweeping curvilinear structure rather than fine noise. Sophisticated architectural editorial design, contemporary premium, fresh and approachable. Composition for website layout: decorative layered arcs sweep across the TOP and BOTTOM of the entire canvas, with a prominent elegant ribbon curling in from the far right edge; right-center 50%-85% horizontal and 25%-70% vertical stays light and calm for dark contact text, but visible contour structure can frame this zone. Left half will be covered by a large company photograph, so don't put all detail there. Use a small number of large graceful shapes with intricate fine parallel lines following their contours; pattern beautiful and apparent at website size. Keep all tones light enough for dark text throughout. Do not create a website mockup. No words, typography, logo, objects, bottles, literal waves/ocean scene, grain, noise, plaster, paper, frost, condensation droplets, marble veining, harsh dark ridges or dark cyan shapes.
